description.subtitle: Real Betis Balompié 2025 2026 Hummel Children's Short Sleeve Training Jersey - Green
description.tagline: Para los futuros talentos del Betis
description.intro: The Hummel Betis children's training T-shirt is designed so that the little ones can train like their idols. Its light and beecool fabric (ventilation and quick drying) allows them to give it their all with green and white pride.
key_benefits: Official training design: Same aesthetic used by Betis players.
Breathable fabric: Incorporates BeeCool technology (ventilation and quick drying).
Active comfort: Comfortable cut to move freely.
Estilo verdiblanco: Con escudo del club y detalles Hummel visibles.
